performance.metric: Adjusted Site EUI (Portfolio Manager models in effect 2021-01-01) for property types that receive an ENERGY STAR score, otherwise Site EUI. DOEE publishes Adjusted Site EUI only on the owner portal, so a public-data estimate uses Site EUI and must be labelled Estimated.

denver.metric: Weather-normalized site EUI for the performance year, less any renewable credit, transportation energy and electrification incentive (tg_v3 glossary "EUI" and section 9.4). Public data has the weather-normalized site EUI but not the credits, so a public-data estimate is an upper bound on the building's EUI.

extended.note: Opt-in when submitting the 2025 benchmarking report: the 2024/2025/2026 interim target moves to 2028, the 2027 interim target is eliminated, and the final target moves from 2030 to 2032.

schedules.open_question: The public dataset does not say which buildings opted into the extension; show both schedules until Denver publishes it or a building's owner supplies it.
